summary: Unpinned third-party GitHub dependency resolved at install time
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever the default branch of that third-party repository currently contains and executes any lifecycle scripts inside it. The source repository is owned by a GitHub account unrelated to the raiden-baileys publisher, so a party other than the package maintainer can at any time push code that will run on every machine that installs this package. Because the source is a mutable branch rather than the npm registry, published-artifact integrity checks do not apply.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
